schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbox_events (local_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source) > 0), posted_at INTEGER, received_at INTEGER NOT NULL, identity_key TEXT, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, android_identity_cipher BLOB CHECK(android_identity_cipher IS NULL OR typeof(android_identity_cipher) = 'blob'), raw_cipher BLOB CHECK(raw_cipher IS NULL OR typeof(raw_cipher) = 'blob'), structured_cipher BLOB CHECK(structured_cipher IS NULL OR typeof(structured_cipher) = 'blob'), state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received' CHECK(state IN ('received','pending','confirmed','ignored','error')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(attempts >= 0), next_attempt_at INTEGER, lease_token TEXT, lease_until INTEGER, raw_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, structured_expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL, error_code TEXT CHECK(error_code IS NULL OR error_code IN ('processing_failed','interrupted','retention_expired','decryption_failed')), confirmation_reference TEXT, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(revision >= 0), CHECK((lease_token IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL) OR (lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL)), CHECK(state != 'confirmed' OR confirmation_reference IS NOT NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbox_identity ON inbox_events(identity_key) WHERE identity_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbox_lease ON inbox_events(lease_token) WHERE lease_token IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbox_ready ON inbox_events(state, next_attempt_at, received_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbox_raw_expiry ON inbox_events(raw_expires_at) WHERE raw_cipher IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inbox_structured_expiry ON inbox_events(structured_expires_at)
insert: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO inbox_events (local_id, source, posted_at, received_at, identity_key, fingerprint, android_identity_cipher, raw_cipher, structured_cipher, raw_expires_at, structured_expires_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
existing: SELECT local_id FROM inbox_events WHERE identity_key = ?
list: SELECT * FROM inbox_events WHERE state = ? ORDER BY received_at, local_id LIMIT ?
claim: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, lease_token = ?, lease_until = ?, attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = (SELECT local_id FROM inbox_events WHERE state = ? AND state IN ('received','error') AND lease_token IS NULL AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= ?) AND structured_expires_at > ? AND attempts < 5 ORDER BY received_at, local_id LIMIT 1) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
update: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = ?, structured_cipher = COALESCE(?, structured_cipher), error_code = ?, next_attempt_at = ?, confirmation_reference = ?, raw_cipher = CASE WHEN ? IN ('confirmed','ignored') THEN NULL ELSE raw_cipher END, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND state = ? AND structured_expires_at > ? AND ((lease_token IS NULL AND ? IS NULL) OR (lease_token = ? AND lease_until > ?)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
recover: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = CASE WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'error' END, error_code = 'interrupted', next_attempt_at = ?, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE lease_until <= ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error')
reviewList: SELECT local_id, source, posted_at, received_at, state, lease_until, structured_cipher, structured_expires_at, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id AND i.reference IS NULL) AS confirmation_pending FROM inbox_events WHERE state IN ('received','pending','error') AND (structured_expires_at > ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id AND i.reference IS NULL)) ORDER BY received_at, local_id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
reviewReserve: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, lease_token = ?, lease_until = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error') AND structured_expires_at > ? AND (lease_token IS NULL OR lease_until <= ?) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
reviewFinish: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = 'pending', structured_cipher = ?, error_code = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND lease_token = ? AND lease_until > ? AND structured_expires_at > ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
reviewFail: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = CASE WHEN state = 'pending' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'error' END, error_code = 'processing_failed', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND lease_token = ? AND lease_until > ? AND structured_expires_at > ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
reviewDiscard: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = 'ignored', raw_cipher = NULL, structured_cipher = NULL, android_identity_cipher = NULL, next_attempt_at = NULL, error_code = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND lease_token = ? AND lease_until > ? AND structured_expires_at > ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
decryptionError: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, state = 'error', error_code = 'decryption_failed', lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE local_id = ? AND state IN ('received','pending','error') AND state = ? AND lease_token IS ? AND revision = ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id)
purgeRaw: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, raw_cipher = NULL WHERE raw_cipher IS NOT NULL AND raw_expires_at <= ?
purgeStructured: UPDATE inbox_events SET revision = revision + 1, structured_cipher = NULL, android_identity_cipher = NULL, raw_cipher = NULL, state = CASE WHEN state IN ('received','pending','error') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id) THEN 'ignored' ELSE state END, error_code = CASE WHEN state IN ('received','pending','error') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id) THEN 'retention_expired' ELSE error_code END, next_attempt_at = NULL, lease_token = NULL, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = ? WHERE structured_expires_at <= ?
confirmationSchema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbox_metadata (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), namespace TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inbox_confirmation_intents (local_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL REFERENCES inbox_events(local_id), event_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, request_cipher BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(request_cipher)='blob'), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, reference TEXT)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS protect_confirmation_state BEFORE UPDATE OF state ON inbox_events WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=OLD.local_id) AND NEW.state NOT IN ('pending','received','error','confirmed') BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Confirmation unresolved'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS protect_event_identity BEFORE UPDATE OF local_id ON inbox_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Immutable event identity'); END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS retain_event_identity BEFORE DELETE ON inbox_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Retain event identity'); END
confirmationBegin: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO inbox_confirmation_intents (local_id,event_key,request_cipher,created_at) SELECT ?,?,?,? FROM inbox_events WHERE local_id=? AND lease_token=? AND lease_until>? AND structured_expires_at>? AND state IN ('received','pending','error')
confirmationPending: SELECT local_id,event_key FROM inbox_confirmation_intents WHERE reference IS NULL ORDER BY created_at,local_id
confirmationFinish: UPDATE inbox_events SET state='confirmed', confirmation_reference=?, raw_cipher=NULL, lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, error_code=NULL, updated_at=?, revision=revision+1 WHERE local_id=? AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inbox_confirmation_intents i WHERE i.local_id=inbox_events.local_id AND i.reference IS NULL) AND state IN ('received','pending','error')
confirmationAcknowledge: UPDATE inbox_confirmation_intents SET reference=? WHERE local_id=? AND reference IS NULL
confirmationDetachLease: UPDATE inbox_events SET lease_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL WHERE local_id=?
